body:
Subject: PR #1933 — the two commits that missed #1932

You merged #1932 at 09:53 at its four-commit head (thanks). Two later commits I pushed to that branch after the merge never reached main; they are now PR #1933 off main: the BUG-1228 fix (one forge detector; forge-aware refs/merge-requests/N/head refspecs for the reviewer pre-flight) and the BUG-1225 follow-up the mirror reviewer asked for (hash-suffixed node names so runner slots do not collide; duplicate #[test] attrs removed). Both verified live on the mirror. Ready for your review once Build passes on its head. STORY-1216 (builder image + incremental mirror builds) is rebased onto main and will get its own PR after its warm-run measurement lands.
